payload.source: GirderDetail Structural analysis, G2 (interior), staged, variable stiffness (steel / 3n / n)
notes: Forces of girder G2 (interior) from GirderDetail's Structural analysis, staged, variable stiffness (steel / 3n / n) line-girder model, continuous. Unfactored: no load factors are applied.

DC1 = steel, deck, haunch and other noncomposite dead load on the steel section (girder self-weight included); DC2 and DW on the long-term composite section. DC1 split (optional fields): M_DC1steel/V_DC1steel = girder flanges and web at 490 pcf × (1 + 5% detail allowance for stiffeners, connection plates and splices) plus the cross-frames and diaphragms as point loads at this girder's frames (34 loads, 5.60 kip in all; K-frames (diagonals meet at the bottom chord), h = 52.00 in: top chord L5x5x3/8, bottom chord L3x3x3/8, diagonals L3x3x3/8; end frames X-type with the same angles; member lengths work point to work point + 10% for gusset plates and bolts); M_DC1wet/V_DC1wet = deck, haunch, SIP forms and any other DC1 rows of the LLDF and DLs module (1.128 klf); both on the steel section, simultaneous (no pour sequence); M_DC1 = their sum (±0.001 rounding).

LL+IM = HL-93 per girder: already multiplied by this girder's distribution factors (multiple presence and skew correction included), IM 33% on the truck and tandem only. The receiver must not apply distribution factors again.

Fatigue (M_FAT, V_FAT) = fatigue truck (3.6.1.4.1) with IM 15% and the single-lane fatigue distribution factors (no multiple presence), unfactored (gamma not applied). Range = positive minus negative.
The pedestrian load is ADDED to LL+IM (as GirderDetail does for its own design demands); M_PL/V_PL give it separately.

Moments sagging positive. Shears in the MIDAS convention of this schema (negative at the left end of a span under gravity load). Shear at a node is the element just right of it; at each interior support there is one station 0.001 ft either side.
Not sent as forces: construction live load (its input is listed in girderDetail.loads), deck placement sequence, wind and flange lateral bending.

Owner load rules of MassDOT (OWN6–OWN8), applied in GirderDetail's own checks, are NOT in these unfactored forces: haunch taken as 0 in composite section properties (deck.haunch is the haunch as entered; the forces come from an analysis with the haunch at 0 in the composite stiffness). They are sent in ownerRules; ST-Girder applies them to its own checks.

ll.title: Live load deflection (owner criterion, mandatory)
ll.ref: MassDOT Bridge Manual Part I 3.5.6.1; AASHTO LRFD 2.5.2.6.2
ll.method: all lanes loaded and all girders deflecting equally (g_Δ from the LLDF and DLs module), HL-93 design truck with IM or 25% of it plus the lane load, short-term composite section with the cracked zones, influence lines of the staged continuous model

camber.method: virtual work on the whole continuous girder: steel and DC1 on the steel section, DC2 + DW on the long-term (3n) composite section, cracked zones where the module uses them; existing utilities on the steel section (the future allowance is not in the camber)
